name: EUPHRASIA OFFICINALIS
key_symptoms: Vomiting from hawking mucus. Nausea and bitterness after smoking.
Bursting headache with dazzling of eyes. Catarrhal headache, with profuse discharge from eyes and nose.

Frequent yawning when walking in open air. Profuse, fluent coryza in morning, with much cough and expectoration. Influenza. Gags when clearing the throat in morning. Whooping-cough only in day-time, with profuse lachrymation.

gi_symptoms: Vomiting from hawking mucus. Nausea and bitterness after smoking.
urinary_symptoms: Spasmodic retraction of genitals, with pressure above pubic bone. Condyloma and sycotic excrescences. Prostatitis. Nocturnal irritability of bladder; dribbling urine.
skin_symptoms: First stage of measles; eye symptoms marked. Consequence of external injuries.
sleep_symptoms: Yawning when walking in open air. Sleepy during day.
fever_symptoms: Chilly and cold. Sweat mostly on chest, at night during sleep.
